::: {.wide}

::: {.lead}
The study moves through the whole of the Kitáb-i-Íqán in fourteen sessions. Each week
covers an assigned span of paragraphs; come having read them and having made an honest
attempt to engage with the text.
:::

You are not expected to understand everything we read — that is why we study together.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" collapse="true"}
## † A note on the Week 10 date

The Week 10 handout carries the heading *“Week 9 | 10 November 2025”* — a copy of the
previous week's header. The session's reading (¶199–219) confirms it is the tenth session,
but its actual date isn't recorded in the materials. Fill it in on this page when you have it.
:::

## How each session runs

Most of our time goes to discussing and reflecting on the text itself. Part of the session is
given to the paragraphs assigned for that week; part to reading and reflecting together on
selected paragraphs brought to the session. There is a break in the middle.

## What to bring

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-tile}
#### The reading, done
Come having read the assigned paragraphs and having made an honest attempt to engage with
the text and reflect on its meaning.
:::

::: {.card-tile}
#### Your questions
Ask anything you have about the material, and respond to the comments and questions others make.
:::

::: {.card-tile}
#### An open mind
Be willing to change your mind if you find someone else's idea better than yours — and make
your best effort to state your view if you disagree.
:::
:::

:::
